blurb: Guests can play bazooka ball, a foam ball launcher game in an interactive arena, mini putt on a glow-in-the-dark course, and arcade games using tokens on a fun card. The centre hosts birthday parties, staff parties, school and youth group events with dedicated party hosts and packages. Activities are suitable for kids ages 4 and up and families.
extraNote: Arcade fun card costs $1.00 · Tokens and prize tickets never expire · Group rate requires 6+ people · Two games for $20 must be purchased by the same individual · Discounts: Buy 1 Mini-Putt, get second 50% off; 10% off Monday to Wednesday
